description: Figure: MNT4 pLDDT with mapped site positions, and ligand distances after superposition; plus GO decision table artifact
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
b4=np.load("plddt_P53745.npy"); b2=np.load("plddt_P53059.npy")
site=pd.read_csv("gt71_site_conservation.csv")
pos4=[int(str(x)[1:]) for x in site['MNT4']]
dist=pd.read_csv("mnt4_ligand_distances.csv")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,7),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.1,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(b4)+1),b4,lw=1.0,color="#2f6fb5",label="MNT4 (P53745) AlphaFold v6")
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
ax.scatter(pos4,b4[[p-1 for p in pos4]],s=38,color="#c0392b",zorder=5,
           label="21 donor/metal-site positions mapped from Mnt2 7XJV")
ax.axvspan(11,29,color="#f0c419",alpha=0.35)
ax.text(20,25,"TM 11-29",rotation=90,fontsize=8,ha="center")
ax.set_xlabel("MNT4 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("MNT4 AlphaFold model: the mapped GDP-mannose / Mn$^{2+}$ site is modelled at high confidence\n"
             "(mean pLDDT at the 21 site positions = %.1f, minimum %.1f)"%(b4[[p-1 for p in pos4]].mean(),b4[[p-1 for p in pos4]].min()),
             fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")

ax=axes[1]
d=dist.sort_values("min_dist_GDPMan")
y=np.arange(len(d))
ax.barh(y-0.19,d["min_dist_GDPMan"],height=0.36,color="#2f7d3a",label="to GDP-mannose (GDD)")
ax.barh(y+0.19,d["min_dist_Mn"],height=0.36,color="#b5651d",label="to Mn$^{2+}$")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(d["MNT4_res"])
ax.axvline(4.5,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8); ax.text(4.6,len(d)-0.6,"4.5 A contact cut-off",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("Minimum side-chain distance to the Mnt2-bound ligand after superposition (A)")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold MNT4 superposed on Mnt2 7XJV chain A (446 core CA, RMSD 1.05 A);\n"
             "Mnt2 ligands transferred into the MNT4 frame",fontsize=11)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- artifact tables ----
go=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(term="GO:0000033 alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity",aspect="MF",
      current_evidence="ISS + IBA only (SGD); no experimental evidence",

      lead="Retain but keep non-experimental evidence code; do NOT upgrade to experimental. Consider generalising to GO:0000030 mannosyltransferase activity because linkage specificity is untested for MNT4"),

      current_evidence="IC + IBA (SGD)",
      this_analysis="PMID 10521541 directly tested mnt4 deletion and found no requirement for O-glycan Man4/Man5 synthesis",
      lead="Remove or do not propagate. The only direct experiment is negative for this process"),

      lead="Do not assert Golgi. Treat as unresolved; a type II membrane topology is supported but the compartment is not"),
